label: Download
title: Download
subtitle: Fetches files from URLs and saves them to the project folder. A safer alternative to the Shell tool for acquiring external files — no command execution involved.
whenToUse: Use when an agent needs to retrieve a PDF, image, dataset, or other file from the internet and make it available locally for subsequent Filesystem or Knowledge Base operations.

methods.name: Download File
methods.description: Downloads a file from a URL into the project's downloads folder. Supports PDF, images, HTML, plain text, and binary files. Returns the local file path.

mediaCaption: A Download File action card showing the source URL and the local path where the file was saved
tips: After downloading, use the Filesystem Read Document tool to extract structured text from PDFs.
